description: Use once before meaningful AI work to create a task session. Provide the provider, model, client, and a 32-byte hash of the task description; returns a unique nonce and EIP-712 authorization signed by the dedicated farming wallet. This writes a pending local task session but does not publish, mint, or submit an on-chain transaction. Pass the returned nonce to complete_ai_task; do not reuse it for another task.

client.description: Host client or agent identifier that starts this task session, from 1 through 64 characters.

model.description: Provider model identifier used for this task, from 1 through 128 characters.

provider.description: AI provider name for this task session, from 1 through 64 characters.

taskHash.description: 32-byte hash of the task description; never send the raw prompt or task text.

name: begin_ai_task
